scripts.dev:doppler: doppler run --config dev -- pnpm run dev
scripts.docker:clean: docker-compose down -v && docker volume rm audit-azurite-data 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.test:all: docker-compose up -d && sleep 5 && vitest run test/api.test.ts test/integration.test.ts test/database-verification.test.ts test/scenarios.test.ts test/public-endpoint.test.ts
scripts.test:ci: docker-compose up -d && sleep 5 && vitest run test/api.test.ts test/integration.test.ts test/database-verification.test.ts test/public-endpoint.test.ts
scripts.test:database: docker-compose up -d && sleep 3 && vitest run test/database-verification.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: docker-compose up -d && sleep 3 && vitest run test/integration.test.ts
scripts.test:local: docker-compose up -d && sleep 3 && vitest run test/api.test.ts
scripts.test:manual: echo 'Starting Azurite and service for manual testing...' && docker-compose up -d && pnpm dev
scripts.test:perf-quick: docker-compose up -d && sleep 3 && vitest run test/performance.test.ts --grep 'Single Request Performance'
scripts.test:performance: docker-compose up -d && sleep 5 && vitest run test/performance.test.ts
scripts.test:public: docker-compose up -d && sleep 3 && vitest run test/public-endpoint.test.ts
scripts.test:scenarios: docker-compose up -d && sleep 3 && vitest run test/scenarios.test.ts
